stages.quote: Surface Mount Technology (SMT) is used to populate the printed circuit boards (PCB), creating one Mainboard printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), five Backbone/Backplane PCBAs, and twenty Tray PCBAs (SIM holders).
The completed PCBAs are placed into a metal enclosure where they are integrated with a Raspberry Pi CM5, and plastic subassemblies inside the enclosure.
Firmware flashing, operating system installation, and system configuration, as well as functional testing and quality control take place next.
Finally, the teh SRX is packaged alongside a 60W Mean Well power supply unit, a C13 power cable, and an ethernet cable before being exported to the United States for retail sale.
